abilities.name: Living Ink
abilities.description: Empower (ABILITY1): Your next 3 bullets come to life, allowing you to steer them as they travel. The bullets deal increased Bullet Damage and splash Spirit Damage in a small area. Each successful hit against a hero reduces all ability cooldowns, and half for all item cooldowns. Draw (ADS): Paint a solid stroke of ink instead that blocks projectiles and characters from passing through. The stroke can be destroyed with a heavy melee, but deals Spirit Damage to the attacker.

upgrades.description: On Empower: Gain +10% Fire Rate for 10s, stacking 5 times
+1s Cooldown Reduction Per Hit Improve scaling

abilities.name: Flow State
abilities.description: Drag a brush that continues to travel forward, leaving a trail that grants bonus slide distance for allies and a fading Slow and Spirit Damage to enemies it passes through, increased the further it travels. Re-activate the ability to flick the brush forward, ending the ability early but dealing Spirit Damage in a larger area.

upgrades.description: On Slide: Gain Damage Amp over time, up to 20% for 6s

abilities.name: Still Life
abilities.description: Choose a hero to be your subject, dealing Spirit DPS as long as you are looking at them. If the sketch is completed they take additional Spirit Damage, suffer from Stun, and drop a sketch that can be picked up. For each collected sketch, you permanently gain stats based on the hero.

upgrades.description: While Drawing: Gain 15 Health Regen, refreshed for 4s on pickup

abilities.name: Abstract Landscape
abilities.description: Create a circular display of ink that blocks vision and grants allies Spirit. Enemies inside are revealed, and leaving causes them to take Spirit Damage and suffer from Silence and Slow, destroying the ink in the process.

upgrades.description: On Buff: +25% Spirit Lifesteal +15 Spirit Power

attributes.playstyle: Holliday depends on her skills as a crack shot, shooting things she's bounced into the air. With good aim she can lay out heavy damage. Her movement skills let her isolate her enemies or beat a hasty retreat.

abilities.name: Powder Keg
abilities.description: Throw a barrel that explodes after a delay, dealing Spirit Damage, setting enemies on fire and applying Knock Up. The barrel can be detonated early by being shot, melee'd, or detonated by another barrel. The burn stacks, so overlapping barrels burn for their combined damage. Can be Alt-Cast to place the barrel in front of Holliday.

upgrades.description: +40 Impact Damage +13.3333 Burn Damage per Second -5s Charge Time Improved Spirit Scaling

abilities.name: Bounce Pad
abilities.description: Drop a bounce pad in the world that launches any hero. You explode on landing, dealing Damage to any nearby enemies. The explosion can only occur once per person per Bounce Pad.

upgrades.description: You and allies gain a +4m/s move speed bonus for 4s on landing

abilities.name: Crackshot
abilities.description: Headshots deal bonus Damage and applies a Fading Move Speed penalty. This effect can only occur when off cooldown. Cooldown is reduced by 50% on NPC hits. Crackshot ignores range damage fall-off and does not apply to objectives.

upgrades.description: -6s Cooldown on Hero Headshots. -3s on NPC Headshots

abilities.name: Spirit Lasso
abilities.description: Throw out your lasso, dealing Spirit Damage, Pulling, and applying Stun. Using a Bounce Pad extends the duration of Spirit Lasso.

attributes.playstyle: Abrams has the bulk and sustain to lead from the front, often running into the middle of his foes and watching them scatter. If his enemies waste their fire on him, his backline teammates can lay out damage with impunity.

weapon.name: Case Closed
weapon.description: Reloads single shells at a time. Can be interrupted

abilities.name: Siphon Life
abilities.description: Drain health from nearby enemies, dealing Spirit DPS and Healing for a portion of the damage dealt.

upgrades.description: +2m Radius and +22 DPS with improved Spirit scaling

abilities.name: Shoulder Charge
abilities.description: Charge forward, Pulling enemies you hit. Pushing a hero into a wall applies Stun. If you collide with a hero you move faster during your charge.

upgrades.description: -18s Cooldown On Hero Collide: +1.5 Weapon Damage for 6s

abilities.name: Infernal Resilience
abilities.description: Gain bonus defensive attributes. Taking damage grants temporary Regen for a portion of the damage taken.

abilities.name: Seismic Impact
abilities.description: Leap high into the air before crashing into the ground, dealing Spirit Damage and applying Stun.

upgrades.description: On cast, become Unstoppable for 5s and +6m Impact Radius

categories: Heroes with single damage spreadshot weapons

abilities.name: Threadsap
abilities.description: Weave a scraggly thread that follows your crosshair before bursting along its path, dealing Spirit Damage and stealing enemy Spirit, increased in effectiveness for Baba. While holding stolen Spirit, Baba deals Bonus Spirit Damage with every bullet.

abilities.name: Granny Long Legs
abilities.description: Your bench's legs extend, granting Bonus Move Speed, higher jumps, Debuff Resistance and Melee Resistance. Light Melee: Perform a kick that knocks enemies back. Heavy Melee: Perform a ground pound that applies Knock Up, Slow, and deals Spirit Damage. Hold Crouch to charge a high jump, release to jump.

abilities.name: Baba's Brew
abilities.description: Brew a pot of tea that applies a magical effect in an area when thrown, cycling over time in a random order between a soothing Combat Barrier, Silence, or scalding burn that deals Spirit DPS and reduces Spirit Resist. Press ADS to pause or resume brewing.

abilities.name: Feed The Birds
abilities.description: Cover targets in front of you with bread, adding a stacking Slow . When the channel ends a flock of pigeons bombard the targets, dealing Spirit Damage and hexing each target into a pigeon, increasing in both damage and duration based on bread count.

upgrades.description: +125 Max Damage +1.5 Spirit Scaling +0.5s Max Duration

attributes.role: Hooks an enemy for a knockout combo
attributes.playstyle: Bebop can string together his abilities in many different ways. Disrupting enemy positions, saving an ally or dealing bursts of damage. When the situation doesn't require subtlety his giant laser still solves many problems.

weapon.name: Humble Pie
weapon.description: Fires a continuous beam with no bullet travel

abilities.name: Exploding Uppercut
abilities.description: Deal Melee Damage to nearby enemies and apply Knock Back. When they land, they deal Spirit Damage and apply Reduced Fire Rate to other nearby enemies. Exploding Uppercut can be used on allies.

upgrades.description: On Hero Hit: Gain fast spin-up time, 2x weapon range and +30% weapon damage for 9s
On Hero Hit: Set Grapple Arm cooldown to 0 and restores +18% of your missing health

abilities.name: Sticky Bomb
abilities.description: Attach a bomb that explodes after a delay, dealing Spirit Damage to nearby enemies. If the bomb hits or kills a hero, you gain permanent bonus damage on Sticky Bomb. Stacks diminish by half after 60 hits and 7 kills

upgrades.description: On Cast: +5m Move Speed and +25% Debuff Resistance for 6s

abilities.name: Grapple Arm
abilities.description: Launch out a mechanical hand that Pulls the first character it hits, reeling them in. Grapple Arm can be used on allies.

abilities.name: Hyper Beam
abilities.description: Channel a powerful torrent of energy that deals Spirit Damage and applies Slow.

upgrades.description: Hyper Beam heals Bebop for 65% of its damage on Heroes. 20% on non-hero

categories: Heroes that don't deal critical damage

abilities.name: Bookwyrm
abilities.description: Conjure a dragon that appears at the target location before flying forward, dealing Spirit Damage and leaving a burning path in its trail.

abilities.name: Plot Armor
abilities.description: Grant an ally a Combat Barrier. While the barrier holds, they gain Bonus Weapon Damage.

upgrades.description: Affects up to 2 additional allies. Increases barrier scaling.

abilities.name: Captivating Read
abilities.description: Target an area with latent magic, applying Slow. The magic detonates after a delay, dealing Spirit Damage and applying Immobilize.

upgrades.description: +2m Radius On Hit: Reduce Spirit Resist by -18% for 6s

abilities.name: Rallying Charge
abilities.description: Release a wave of spectral knights and steeds that charge across the entire city, Healing allies and dealing Spirit Damage to enemies. The strength of the Heal and Spirit Damage is amplified as the knights travel further.

abilities.name: Setup Bishop
abilities.description: Create a bishop that remains in place indefinitely. Move (ADS): Moves the bishop, applying a fading Slow and dealing Spirit Damage to enemies it passes through. After a delay, activates diagonal squares that deal additional Spirit Damage when stepped on. Re-activate to recall all bishops, ending the ability.

upgrades.description: +1 Square Range Impacts reduce Spirit Resist by -5%, stacking 5 times

abilities.name: Kingside Knight
abilities.description: Promote an ally to be a knight, granting bonus stamina and Combat Barrier for a duration. If self-cast you develop yourself as king instead, granting double the Combat Barrier but no stamina. Move (ADS): Moves the piece, making it invulnerable during the duration before landing. If self-cast, re-activate the ability to move instead.

upgrades.description: Can target two allies within radius. On Self: Remove all debuffs after a move

abilities.name: Rook Battery
abilities.description: Release a pair of rooks that travel forward, dealing Spirit Damage and applying Immobilize. If the rooks hit a wall, they reflect back in the opposite direction. Re-Activate: Split the rooks perpendicularly.

upgrades.description: On Hit: Reduce 25% Fire Rate for 5s
On Hit: 5% Current Health as Damage

abilities.name: Develop Queen
abilities.description: Summon a queen that crashes down, dealing Spirit Damage in an area. After a delay, the queen releases squares in straight lines that deal Spirit Damage again and apply Stun. Heroes hit that are low health are checkmated, executing them. Move (ADS): The queen leaps to the target location, dealing the same effects again. Re-activate to recall the queen early, ending the ability.

attributes.playstyle: Manipulating time lets Paradox outpace an enemy in one on one combat. She thrives by subjecting her enemies to timely swaps into a waiting pulse grenade, her wall, or into the middle of her teammates.

abilities.name: Pulse Grenade
abilities.description: Throw a grenade that begins pulsing when it lands. Each pulse expands the radius and applies Spirit Damage, time slow, and stacking Damage Amp for Paradox against the victim.

upgrades.description: +20 Pulse Damage and increased Spirit scaling

abilities.name: Time Wall
abilities.description: Create a time warping wall that stops time for all enemy projectiles and bullets that touch it and increases the speed and damage of friendly bullets. Enemies that touch the wall will be briefly slowed.

abilities.name: Kinetic Carbine
abilities.description: Charge up a powerful shot of time energy, dealing Spirit Damage and applying a Time-Stop to enemies hit. The damage dealt increases with Weapon Damage. Move speed is increased while charging. While in the air and charging, ADS to timeslow your movement.

upgrades.description: +2s Charge Hold Duration and +55% Damage Scaling

abilities.name: Paradoxical Swap
abilities.description: Fire a projectile that swaps your position with the target enemy hero.

upgrades.description: 200 Barrier for 8s. Barrier scales with Spirit
Swaps all enemies within 7m of hit target and +10% Max Health Damage

categories: Heroes that don't deal critical damage

abilities.name: Strix Salvo
abilities.description: Launch a salvo of spirit missiles that lodge into the ground along a line. The missiles explode after a delay or upon detecting an enemy, dealing Spirit Damage and marking the target. Shooting a marked enemy with a charged shot consumes a mark to deal Bonus Spirit Damage and apply a fading Slow. Hold and drag to select the angle.

upgrades.description: +2 Missiles, Longer Range, and Improved Spirit Scaling

abilities.name: Chimera Mk1
abilities.description: Hold Mantle to fly, building up heat. When max heat is reached, your jetpack will begin to overheat. Overheating: After a short delay, dive to the ground. Upon impact, create an explosion that deals damage and launches you and nearby enemies. If no hero is hit, you stun yourself. Press Ability2 to dive early. Cooling Down: After overheating, the jetpack cannot be used until it fully cools down. Slows affect you while airborne. You always explode on death.

upgrades.description: On Hero Hit: Heal and take no self damage
On Hero Hit: -50% Cooldown and +120 Spirit Damage

abilities.name: Jettison Fuel
abilities.description: Spray fuel dealing Weapon DPS and shredding Bullet Resist, building up to a huge backblast that deals Spirit Damage and knocks you backwards. Vents the jetpack when dealing damage.

upgrades.description: +60 Burst Damage On Backblast Hit: +18% Fire Rate for 7s
-10% Bullet Resist Shred On Backblast Hit: Apply a Mark

abilities.name: Close The Deal
abilities.description: Grab an enemy and give them a hands-on demonstration, flying high into the air before crashing back to the ground. You and the participant take Spirit DPS while falling and Spirit Damage upon impact. Damage is increased to enemies under 50% health.

abilities.name: Call Bell
abilities.description: Throw out a call bell that deals Spirit Damage on impact. After a short delay it explodes, dealing additional Spirit Damage and causing affected enemies to suffer reduced weapon accuracy and movement Slow. Can be shot to detonate early.

abilities.name: Doorway
abilities.description: Place two connected doors in the world. Players and most projectiles entering one door will exit out through the other. The doors will close at the end of the duration. The two doors must be placed within the doorway distance of each other.

upgrades.description: Grants a Barrier first time traveling through doors
+30m Cast Range. +40m Doorway Distance and scales with Spirit Power.

abilities.name: Luggage Cart
abilities.description: Send out a Luggage Cart that deals Spirit Damage and Pulls enemy heroes along its path. Can be alt cast with Alt Cast to target friendly heroes instead.

upgrades.description: +25m Cast Range +90 Damage on wall impact
-18s Cooldown and 1.25s Stun on wall impact

abilities.name: Hotel Guest
abilities.description: Send the target's physical body to be a guest at the Baroness Hotel. The guest is to promptly make their way to the exit elevator, where they'll be sent back to their original position. A stay at the Baroness Hotel is paid for in Spirit Damage. Failure to check-out on time costs additional Spirit Damage.

upgrades.description: +150 Damage +1.5s Stun on Failure to Check Out
Unstoppable while the Baroness is occupied. 15s Cooldown on Failure to Check Out.

categories: Heroes with single damage spreadshot weapons

abilities.name: Rend
abilities.description: Swipe at enemies in a cone ahead of you, dealing Spirit Damage. If the enemy is in close range, deal bonus Melee Damage.

upgrades.description: Deals 55% Heavy Melee Damage Silences enemies for 2s if close range

abilities.name: Stalker's Mark
abilities.description: Send out a mark that bleeds the first target it hits, dealing Spirit DPS. While the enemy is bleeding you can re-activate Stalker's Mark to instantly appear behind their back.

abilities.name: Bloodscent
abilities.description: When enemy heroes are low on health you deal amplified damage against them. These enemies leave a lingering blood trail as they move.

upgrades.description: +3m/s Move Speed when around an isolated enemy hero
On isolated hero death: Heal 24% of your missing health and restores 2 Stamina

abilities.name: Eternal Night
abilities.description: Surround nearby enemy heroes in darkness, severely limiting their vision of other units. Affected enemies are briefly revealed to you and are considered isolated for the duration. You gain Bonus Sprint Speed.

attributes.playstyle: Dynamo keeps himself and his allies healthy while waiting for his moment. Few things can warp a team fight more than a well-coordinated use of Singularity.

abilities.name: Kinetic Pulse
abilities.description: Release an energy pulse that travels along the ground, dealing Spirit Damage and applying Knock Up.

upgrades.description: On Hit: -15% Bullet Resist and -24% Move Speed for 4s

abilities.name: Quantum Entanglement
abilities.description: Briefly become untargetable while teleporting to the target location. Restores stamina upon use. Alt Cast: Bring nearby allies with you.

upgrades.description: Reduces non-ult debuffs by 50% Replenishes 1 Charge

abilities.name: Rejuvenating Aurora
abilities.description: While channeling, restore health over time to you and any allies nearby. You can dash and melee without breaking the channel.

upgrades.description: Aura provides +4m Move Speed during channel
Full move and ability use and additionally heals +2.5% of Max Health per second

abilities.name: Singularity
abilities.description: Create a singularity in your hands, dealing Spirit DPS, applying Stun, and pulling in nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Pillow Toss
abilities.description: Throw your trusty pillow inflicting Spirit Damage and heavy Knock Back. Landing hits reduces the cooldown of your other abilities.

abilities.name: Tag Along
abilities.description: Jump to an ally and nap alongside them. Both you and the ally receive a burst Heal based on missing health followed by lingering Regen. Hop between allies with Ability2 to apply the heal, once per ally. You are knocked off if stunned by an ultimate ability. You can use items and all self-casts target your ally instead.

upgrades.description: 35% Bonus Item Range, Duration, and Barrier Effectiveness while napping
+15% Spirit Power and +35 Spirit Power while napping and for 10s after napping Improved Spirit Scaling

abilities.name: Lil Helpers
abilities.description: Signal a Helper to lend a hand. They can collect boxes, do Sinner's Sacrifices, or be sent to support allies and troopers. Follow a hero: Provides a short burst of Spirit Resist and fading Move Speed. Follow a trooper: Provides healing, damage, resists, and allows tagging along. When no hero is around, souls from trooper kills are split amongst the team. Can be cast during Tag Along. Helpers will take a nap for 15.1s after following someone.

abilities.name: Naptime
abilities.description: Cast your gaze forward, piercing walls and floors. Enemies in the gaze are slowed, have reduced dash distance, and cannot use movement abilities. When the channel ends they fall asleep before waking up to a splitting headache that deals heavy Spirit Damage.

upgrades.description: -1 Stamina On Wake and no Stamina Regen while sleeping
-55s cooldown Reduced damage and unstoppable while channeling

categories: Heroes with no weapon damage falloff

abilities.name: Disengaging Sigil
abilities.description: Draw a sigil sphere in front of you and then leap backwards as it explodes, damaging and slowing enemies caught in it.

upgrades.description: Gain +25% Fire Rate and +25% Bullet Speed for 8s
On Player Hit: +1 stamina restored and resets Air Jump/Dash limit

abilities.name: Riposte
abilities.description: Prepare to deflect the next incoming attack. On a successful deflection, briefly become invulnerable and target an enemy hero to dash towards them, immobilizing and disarming them, preventing them from parrying, and reducing their Melee Resist. Press Ability2 to select a target. Does not trigger against trooper or neutral damage.

upgrades.description: Gain 75% Bullet, Spirit & Melee Lifesteal against the Riposte target for 13s

abilities.name: Flawless Advance
abilities.description: Perform a series of lunges in any direction, delivering piercing stabs ahead of you. Hold your ability key to time your attacks, dealing more damage the longer it's held. Releasing your attack during the perfect window deals maximum damage. Press Ability3 to re-cast.

upgrades.description: -12s Cooldown. Gain +60% Bullet Resist during lunge
+65 Perfect Damage with improved Spirit scaling. Increased lunge speed & distance.

abilities.name: Itani Lo Sahn
abilities.description: Charge up and perform a long range slash. Struck enemies cannot take action or heal and are stuck in slow motion. When this effect expires, they suffer devastating damage, dealing bonus damage against half-health enemies. While in slow motion, Apollo is invulnerable and enemies take reduced damage. Hold Ability4 or Attack to delay the cast.

attributes.role: Controls the battle with combat turrets
attributes.playstyle: Precise placement is everything for McGinnis, whether she's creating a killzone or splitting the enemy team. She can help keep her team running making them hard to dislodge when entrenched.

weapon.name: Services Rendered
weapon.description: Increases fire rate as the gun spins up

abilities.name: Mini Turret
abilities.description: Deploy a turret that shoots enemies, dealing Spirit DPS. The turret expires after a limited lifetime. Turrets deal reduced damage to troopers and objectives.

upgrades.description: +25% Turret Fire Rate and +12s Turret Lifetime

abilities.name: Medicinal Specter
abilities.description: Deploy a spirit that provides Healing to nearby allies.

upgrades.description: +2% Max HP Regen +3m Heal Radius +40% Spirit Resist

abilities.name: Spectral Wall
abilities.description: Cast a wall that applies slow on enemies it passes through. Erupt the wall to divide the terrain in half and damage nearby enemies. After casting, pressAttackorAbility3to erupt the wall early. Can be Destroyed with Melee Attacks

upgrades.description: Amplifies McGinnis's damage by +20% on hit enemies for 7s
Deploy 2 Mini Turrets near the wall for 8s +24% Slow

abilities.name: Heavy Barrage
abilities.description: Unleashes a volley of rockets that home in on a targeted location. McGinnis is slowed and is still able to use stamina.

upgrades.description: Applies 24% movement and dash slow for 1s
+2m Radius and +15 Damage per Rocket with increased spirit scaling

abilities.name: Pain Battery
abilities.description: Taking any damage passively charges up your Pain Battery. Once full, activating the ability fires multiple shocking bolts, dealing Spirit Damage once per target.

upgrades.description: On Hero Hit: Heal for 15% of your missing health and increased Spirit scaling

abilities.name: Jumpstart
abilities.description: Deal Spirit Damage to yourself. Then, gain bonus Regen and Bonus Move Speed, decaying over time.

upgrades.description: +1 Charge +50% Debuff Resistance Increases spirit scaling

abilities.name: Aura of Suffering
abilities.description: Unleash pain, dealing Spirit DPS to both enemies and yourself. The damage continues to increase the longer the ability is channeled, up to a maximum amount.

upgrades.description: Enemies receive 20% Move and Dash Slow

abilities.name: Shocking Reanimation
abilities.description: Release a wave after taking lethal damage, applying a diminishing Slow. After a brief channel you reanimate, dealing Spirit Damage and applying Stun to nearby enemies.

upgrades.description: While On Cooldown: Gain +15% Fire Rate and 6 Spirit Damage per Bullet

attributes.role: Sacrifices health then drains it back
attributes.playstyle: Expending health to achieve devastating effects is the source of Lady Geist's power. When running low, she can drain the life out of her rivals.

abilities.name: Essence Bomb
abilities.description: Sacrifice some of your health to launch a bomb that deals damage after a brief arm time. Self damage type is Spirit and can be mitigated.

upgrades.description: Bombs leave a toxic mess on the ground, dealing 30% of the original damage per second, for 6s.

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.description: Create a tether that drains enemy health over time and heals you. Target must be in line of sight and within max range to drain. You can shoot and use other abilities during the drain, but your move speed is reduced. Alt Cast to give health to friendly Heroes.

upgrades.description: Enables and Grants +2 Charges. Increases spirit scaling.

abilities.name: Malice
abilities.description: Sacrifice some of your health to launch blood shards that apply a stack of Malice. Each stack slows the victim and increases the damage they take from you. The slow effect decreases over time.

abilities.name: Soul Exchange
abilities.description: Swaps health levels with an enemy target. There is a minimum health percentage that enemies can be brought down to and a minimum amount of health received based on victims current health.

upgrades.description: On cast, +60 Spirit Power, +40% Fire Rate and +50% Spirit Resistance for 8s.

attributes.playstyle: Seven thrives in a skirmish waiting for the time to strike. Then he rolls into the fight like a storm and batters his enemies with a cascade of lightning.

abilities.name: Lightning Ball
abilities.description: Shoot a ball of lightning that travels in a straight line. Does damage to all targets in its radius. Slows down when damaging enemies and stops if it hits the world.

upgrades.description: -28% move speed on hit targets and +1s Lifetime

abilities.name: Static Charge
abilities.description: Apply a charge to a target enemy hero. After a short duration, the static charge stuns and damages enemies within the radius.

abilities.name: Power Surge
abilities.description: Power up your weapon with a shock effect, making your bullets proc shock damage on your target. This shock damage bounces to enemies near your target. Occurs once per burst shot.

upgrades.description: +3m Move Speed +8 Damage and increased scaling

abilities.name: Storm Cloud
abilities.description: Channel an expanding storm cloud around you that damages all enemies within its radius. Enemies do not take damage when they are out of line-of-sight.

upgrades.description: +55% Bullet Resist while channeling Storm Cloud
+7s Channel Time +10m Final Radius +5m Initial Radius

attributes.playstyle: When Haze fixates on a target she can hold her own in a firefight. She prefers to create one sided exchanges, avoiding damage then picking off unsuspecting targets up close.

abilities.name: Sleep Dagger
abilities.description: Throw a dagger that damages and sleeps the target. Sleeping targets wake up shortly after being damaged. Throwing a Dagger does not break your invisibility. Sleep Dagger does not interrupt enemies' channeling abilities.

upgrades.description: -10% Bullet Resist Reduction for 6s on wake-up
-17s Cooldown -40% Move and Dash Speed for 3s on wake-up

abilities.name: Smoke Bomb
abilities.description: Fade out of sight, becoming invisible and gaining sprint speed. Attacking removes invisibility, but using items does not. Close enemies can see through your invisibility.

upgrades.description: Dispels non-ult debuffs Grants +50% Bullet Lifesteal for 5s

abilities.name: Fixation
abilities.description: Shooting a target increases your bullet damage on that target. Gain one stack per bullet hit, three if the hit is a headshot.

upgrades.description: 40 Spirit damage and 12% slow for 2s to target every 20 stacks
+0.11/ per Stack Scales with Weapon Damage

abilities.name: Bullet Dance
abilities.description: Enter a flurry, firing your weapon at nearby enemies with perfect accuracy and added Bullet Damage.

attributes.playstyle: Vindicta has the mobility to engage at her leisure, picking at her prey and bleeding them out slowly. Injured enemies at any distance should fear being picked off when she is on the map.

abilities.name: Stake
abilities.description: Throw a stake that tethers enemies to the location where the stake lands. Enemy movement is restricted to the length of the tether.

abilities.name: Flight
abilities.description: Leap into the air and fly. While in flight your weapon deals bonus spirit damage and your items have increased range.

upgrades.description: Hero Kills Refresh Duration. +10 Spirit Damage with increased Spirit scaling

abilities.name: Crow Familiar
abilities.description: Your crow familiar deals impact damage, reduces their bullet resist and applies a bleed that deals damage based on the target's current health.

abilities.name: Assassinate
abilities.description: Use your scoped rifle to fire a powerful shot over long distances. Deal only partial damage until fully charged after 1s of being scoped. Does bonus damage to enemies with less than 50% health remaining. Landing a killing blow on a player with Assassinate grants you bonus weapon damage.

attributes.role: Lights up enemies and watches them burn
attributes.playstyle: Infernus has many ways to deal damage over time, burning foes before swooping in for the kill. Due to Infernus' blazing speed, his enemies won't be able to escape the flames.

abilities.name: Napalm
abilities.description: Spew an incendiary mixture, dealing Spirit Damage, applying Slow, and coating targets in napalm.

upgrades.description: Napalm Effect: +17% Damage Taken and -33% Healing

abilities.name: Flame Dash
abilities.description: Dash forward, gaining Slow Resistance while leaving a flaming trail that deals Spirit DPS. HoldMove Forwardwhile active to dash farther.

upgrades.description: Enable 2 Ability Charges with 14s Recharge time

abilities.name: Afterburn
abilities.description: Weapon hits build up a burning effect, dealing Spirit DPS. Abilities refresh to the base burn duration and weapon hits extend it.

abilities.name: Concussive Combustion
abilities.description: Become a living bomb, dealing Spirit Damage and applying Stun to all nearby enemies after a delay. Once cast, Concussive Combustion cannot be interrupted.

upgrades.description: +0.9s Stun Duration and +10m Radius Increased Spirit Scaling

attributes.playstyle: Timely heals and splitting a teamfight properly is the difference between an easy victory or a ruinous defeat. Gliding around slowing enemies gives Kelvin's team the maneuvering advantage to make this happen.

abilities.name: Frost Grenade
abilities.description: Throw a grenade that explodes in a cloud of freezing ice that Heals allies and applies Spirit Damage and move speed reduction to enemies.

upgrades.description: -10 Cooldown and debuff now freezes Stamina Regen
+2m Radius. Damage and Heal Spirit Scaling increased.

abilities.name: Ice Path
abilities.description: Kelvin creates a floating trail of ice and snow that gives movement bonuses to him and his allies. Kelvin gains 60% slow resistance for the duration. Enemies can also walk on the floating trail. Press Roll / Crouch to travel up or down while in Ice Path.

upgrades.description: +2m Move Speed and +35% Bullet Resist for Kelvin while on Ice Path
+35% Spirit and +20 Spirit for Kelvin while on Ice Path

abilities.name: Arctic Beam
abilities.description: Shoot freezing cold energy out in front of you, damaging targets and progressively reducing their movement and fire rate the longer you sustain the beam on them. You have reduced move speed while using Arctic Beam. The beam may also claim Souls.

upgrades.description: -20% to Fire Rate and Move Speed
-13s Cooldown and Fires 2 additional Arctic Beams within 10m of the last target hit.

abilities.name: Frozen Shelter
abilities.description: Target yourself or a Hero to freeze the air and create an impenetrable dome around them. While in the dome, allies gain rapid Regen and enemies are slowed. Objectives become Invulnerable and Frozen under Frozen Shelter

upgrades.description: Purges non-ult debuffs for you and your allies. +75 Health Regen and increased Spirit Scaling

attributes.playstyle: By burrowing through the ground, Mo and Krill can get the drop on almost anyone; and once they get in close the results can be devastating.

abilities.name: Scorn
abilities.description: Deal damage to nearby enemies and heal yourself based on the damage done. Heal is stronger against enemy heroes.

upgrades.description: Adds a debuff to enemies that lets Mo & Krill deal +15% Damage to them. Stacks and lasts 16s.

abilities.name: Burrow
abilities.description: Burrow underground, moving faster, and gaining spirit and bullet armor. Damage from enemy heroes will reduce the speed bonus. When you jump out, deal Spirit Damage, Slow, and Knock Up.

abilities.name: Sand Blast
abilities.description: Spray sand that disarms enemies in front of you and deals damage.

upgrades.description: Slow targets by -28% and reduces dash distances by -28%

abilities.name: Combo
abilities.description: Hold the target in place, stunning them and dealing damage during the channel. If they die during, or within 3 seconds of Combo ending, you permanently gain max health.

upgrades.description: +0.7s Duration and +35 Damage Per Second and increased scaling

attributes.role: Dives down to stomp his foes
attributes.playstyle: Lash gives his enemies little room to breathe, either by flying in from long distances to initiate combat with unsuspecting enemies, or pursuing said enemies when they try to run.

abilities.name: Ground Strike
abilities.description: Stomp the ground beneath you, damaging enemies in front of you. If you perform Ground Strike while airborne, you quickly dive towards the ground. Damage grows slower after 25m.
